item.title: Random Cellular Automata and deBruijn Graphs
item.description: arXiv:2610.31764v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Update rules of a one dimensional Cellular Automaton can be expressed using an edge-labeled deBruijn graph. We explore various questions about the image of a cellular automaton given by a randomly selected update rule by considering a random deBruijn graph.
item.dc:creator: Janko Gravner, Travis Kulhanek
